0.content: Surtalogi is one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, a former knight of Khaenri'ah who abandoned the chivalric code, gained world-shattering Abyssal power and left Teyvat to seek worthy opponents among the stars. He found Skirk in the ruins of her world, fed her, healed her and trained her by breaking her body daily until her limbs became Abyssal phantasms. He told her he had saved her on a whim. He feared he would one day grow bored once nothing could challenge him, so he took disciples to ripen into opponents. He promised that once she left, he would strip her of everything she had. Skirk says people follow him for his strength, composure and candour, and that his drive to perfect himself is why he is both powerful and dangerous.

1.content: At fourteen, Ajax ran from his monotonous life in Morepesok, got lost in a snowy forest and fell into an Abyssal rift. There a mysterious swordswoman, Skirk, taught him for three months to pass through the Abyss unhindered and to fight; only three days passed outside. He came home changed, and his path led to the Fatui and the rank of Eleventh Harbinger. She beat him one-handed, which he calls her "arrogance" and means as praise. He says she is an alright cook and regrets she never tried his family's homemade sausages. Her own verdict: he has talent and no fear, but she has seen many bright sparks fizzle out before their prime.

2.content: Skirk's unnamed planet was once too hot or cold for life, but its humans evolved to adapt to any environment or energy source, including the Abyss, which they lived beside without ever using. Traders from a neighbouring planet arrived with smiles and talk of friendship. Months later an army followed and exterminated the people as a "potential threat", killing the native life as well. Skirk, who had skipped school that day, came home to fire. Her parents, the only ones who fought back, told her to run and never look back.

3.comment: Skirk: Abyssal body and the Seven-Shifting Serpent
3.content: Her arms and legs, ruined when she was dug from the rubble, were replaced over years of training by phantasms of Abyssal energy that never hurt; her overloaded pain sense went numb. She can form new limbs. The Seven-Shifting Serpent, a trick Surtalogi taught her before she left, lets her disguise Abyssal power as one of Teyvat's seven elements. She chose Cryo, because the elements are the "natural order" there and the disguise lets her stay hidden longer.

4.content: Every civilization Skirk met on her travels took her for part of the "Cosmic Calamity" and kept its distance, except Teyvat. There Alice, the Sustainer of the World's Borders, lowered her guard after talking with her and granted limited passage on condition that Skirk not interfere much in the world's affairs. Alice compared this to ecologists who watch predators hunt without intervening: "some call this being a callous observer, but I think it's merciful at the same time."

5.comment: Skirk: The Primordial Sea and the Gnosis warning (4.2)
5.content: At the climax of Fontaine's prophecy, after the Traveler and Neuvillette brought down the All-Devouring Narwhal, a woman shrank the beast down with Abyssal power and tossed it and the unconscious Childe through a rift. It had been meant as her own private training session, she said; her disciple and her master's pet had simply met before she expected. She declared that the Traveler, having won without "power from beyond this world", could speak to her as an equal. She named her master and warned that the narwhal's spent Hydro would now flood Fontaine.

6.comment: Skirk: Crystallina Chapter: Whispers Betwixt Stars and Night
6.content: In Liyue the Traveler suffered chest pains and nightmares. At Wanmin Restaurant Skirk sat down beside them, ordered wine, diagnosed a torn soul bearing Abyssal corrosion, then left in a way that made Chef Mao forget she had been there. At Guili Plains they found Rifthounds digging up god remains for an unknown thief of divine power. She offered a deal: help her find the thief and she would recover the missing soul. She took the Traveler into the Abyss for intensive training, then led a raid on the thief's lair under the Chasm.
